contexts.text: The derivative falsity and evil is a wanderer and fugitive in the earth ().
To be a wanderer and fugitive in the earth = not to know what is true and good.
To wander blind in the streets () = not to know what is good and true.
To wander to drink waters () = to seek what is true. AE 532:8.
Those who have divested themselves of all charity, wander and flee (homeless).
Nod is a word which means to be a wanderer and a fugitive.
Those who have contracted a nature of speaking one thing and thinking another... wander around...
Desolation is described by to wander before swords... ().
Celestial things... are signified by... to meet the wanderer with bread ().
To wander from sea to sea () = to seek where there are Knowledges.
(The Spirits of the isthmus of the brain) are of the wandering Societies. AC 5189. SE 3822.
Wander through the land, trading () = to enter into the Knowledges of good and truth.
Wandering Spirits of the infernal crew who... strive to enter into man's taste. Described.
They do not allow another to wander from his own idea...
These Spirits (of the province of the chyle) are among the wandering Spirits. SE 1136.
These satellites range round their respective globes...
The Spirits of Mercury... wander through the universe. Explained.
This is why such wander hither and thither in the World of Spirits.
There are bonds to keep them from roaming extravagentur (into new evil).
An indescribable fear withheld him from going beyond limits.
A Society of these evil Spirits was represented by...
Beyond the sphere (of these particulars) the thoughts and speech cannot go.
Woe unto them, for they have wandered from Me () = a turning away from the truths which are from the Word.
These things were represented by the wandering... of the sons of Israel in the wilderness.

In consequence of the death of charity the Church perishes, which is signified by... becoming a wanderer and a fugitive; for when faith is separated from charity, truth is successively turned into falsity...
Whereby his mind becomes wandering and unsettled.
